engine_basis: Vendored PHP8.5.10 commit34308a6666b2d489c509541ea9befea9e2b42348: zend_compile_assign propagates reference leaves and emits MAKE_REF before targets, then zend_compile_list_assign uses FETCH_LIST_R for value leaves and FETCH_LIST_W/MAKE_REF for reference leaves.

The saved reference wrapper holds its original cell after the RHS CV is unset/rebound. Value assignment changes that cell's contents; later reference acquisition performs ordinary writable conversion/COW against its current value. A missing FETCH_LIST_R returns uninitialized/null without repeating the lookup.

The VM checks a handler exception before the pending target store. Existing operand/task ownership supplies one HCELL owner through dispatch, callback frames and normal/throw cleanup; assignment-result delivery resolves that saved cell after the targets.
reviewed_behavior: Source/shape/index/tail/key/compiler-line checks authenticate the interrupted value fetch. Mixed resume requires an allocated marked in-bounds source HCELL, without requiring its current CV binding, array type or original table identity. Only the initial plan checks the current table for a missing key.

A returning handler that inserts the selected key or replaces the table still delivers NULL for the interrupted fetch. Later reference targets read the live saved cell; NULL replacement permits array creation. Earlier reference targets remain visible, and reference leaves retain their fetch/key line rather than adopting the target line.

Unset/rebind leaves the old source cell with a sole task owner. A later reference fetch separates its shared table from a retained copy, binds the old entry and delivers that table as the result; new global aliases stay separate. Actual raw acquisition/binding and driver retirement are distinguished.

A supplied handler throw preserves Throwable identity/Previous, callback writes and the caller destination; it cancels the pending store, later leaves and result delivery, retiring the otherwise unowned source cell, runtime array and embedded reference cell.
Known-array nonreference admission is pointwise equivalent to A2. No A1/A2 source/state check was replayed or renewed; no task, module, ownership projection or generic read/write helper changed.
